roasts.goal: extend development to cook dense core, smooth RoR decay, drop ~197C
roasts.cupping_notes: Pre-cup roast review: Visual appearance came out quite dark despite never reaching first crack. The 8m46s duration and 45s stall at 189.1C baked the sugary anoxic natural skin. Strategy for next roast: front-load aggressive heat early during dry phase to penetrate dense core, then a smooth shallow glide into FC at ~3-4 C/min RoR for a brief gentle crack and immediate drop to keep color light.

roasts.cupping_notes: Not formally cupped yet. Pre-cup impression: too dark. Actual DTR came out 12.5% (FC 351s, drop 401s) vs a 19% plan target the user now says was too high — they want DTR closer to 5-10%. Also wants RoR to enter FC around 6 C/min and cut hard to ~3 C/min quickly after, to minimize browning.
